reply:
The claim is staged for human approval: a €600 payout with no assessor needed. I checked the subagent's figures against the contract (company document 2630) and they hold.

**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: baseline-haiku-CLM-01. Policy VER-1004, Thomas Petit, VW Golf 2020, market value €15,500.
- Coverage: C2 Collision damage, which is listed in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident on 3 October 2026, reported on 4 October 2026 (one day later).
- The customer reversed into a concrete pillar. No third party was involved.
- Repair quote: €900. Photos (damage_photos.zip) and repair_quote.pdf are on file, so no documents are missing. I could not open either file.
- The driver is the policyholder, with no sign of a possible exclusion. The licence dates from 2008, so the young-driver surcharge does not apply.

**Reasoning**
- Coverage: C2 is in the Policy Schedule, so it is covered. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1" name="Veridia Motor Insurance Contract"/>
- Deductible: C2 standard deductible is €300. No not-at-fault waiver applies, and the young-driver surcharge (Art. 5.3) does not apply because the licence is more than 3 years old. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1-2"/>
- Reporting: reported one day after the incident, which is within the deadline in Art. 4.1 (I did not re-read the wording of Art. 4.1 myself; the claims system marked it on time). <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2"/>
- Assessor: not required, because the repair cost (€900) is not above €1,500 (Art. 6.1). <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2"/>
- Payout: repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible (Art. 6.2). Compensation is never negative. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2"/>
- Payment is made within 15 days after a Veridia claims handler approves it (Art. 6.3). <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2-3"/>

**Amounts** (from the settlement tool)
- Deductible: €300 (Art. 5 and the C2 standard deductible)
- Payout: €600 (€900 repair cost minus €300 deductible)
- Assessor required: No

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting your claim (reference baseline-haiku-CLM-01) for the incident of 3 October 2026. We have received your damage photos and the €900 repair quote. Your claim has been passed for review, and a settlement proposal is now being checked by our claims team. We will contact you with the outcome as soon as the review is complete.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team

A human claims handler still needs to approve the €600 before payment is made.
